topic: the Sun's center of mass sits outside its own surface because of Jupiter (barycenter)
title: The Sun's Center of Mass Isn't Even Inside The Sun
description: Turns out the Sun isn't as 'centered' as it looks. Jupiter is massive enough to drag the solar system's balance point (the barycenter) just outside the Sun's own surface. Original AI-narrated commentary on a real astrophysics fact -- not affiliated with any other creator. #space #shorts #astronomy #jupiter #sciencefacts

hook_candidates.text: Jupiter is heavy enough to drag the Sun's own center of mass outside its surface.

What if the Sun you picture as perfectly still is actually looping around empty space?
